scripts.build: npm run build -w @llm-wiki/vault-contracts && npm run build -w @llm-wiki/obsidian-vault-bridge
scripts.sandcastle:docker:build: docker build --network host --build-arg HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7890 --build-arg HTTPS_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7890 --build-arg NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1,::1,172.16.0.0/12,10.0.0.0/8 --build-arg AGENT_UID=$(id -u) --build-arg AGENT_GID=$(id -g) -t sandcastle:obsidian-llm-wiki-cli -f .sandcastle/Dockerfile .
scripts.sandcastle:reviewer:docker:build: docker build --network host --build-arg HTTP_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7890 --build-arg HTTPS_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:7890 --build-arg NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1,::1,172.16.0.0/12,10.0.0.0/8 --build-arg AGENT_UID=$(id -u) --build-arg AGENT_GID=$(id -g) -t sandcastle:obsidian-llm-wiki-cli-reviewer -f .sandcastle/reviewer.Dockerfile .
